title: Issue
description: A single vertical slice decomposed from an Epic. Each issue cuts end-to-end through all relevant integration layers and is independently implementable.

glId.description: Glossary term identifier. Format: GL-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

id.description: Issue identifier. Format: IS-NNN (3-digit zero-padded, project-global, sequential).

type.description: AFK: agent can implement without human interaction. HITL: requires human input at some point.

epic.description: Parent epic identifier. Format: EP-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

blocked_by.description: List of IS-NNN identifiers that block this issue. Empty array if none.

milestone.description: Milestone identifier. Format: M1, M2, etc.

titleGlossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in this issue's title.

inScope.description: Specific deliverables and behaviors this issue covers (subset of parent epic scope).

outOfScope.description: Things explicitly excluded from this issue to prevent scope creep.

inScopeGlossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in inScope items.

outOfScopeGlossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in outOfScope items.

acGlossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in the acceptance criteria.
